title: VITA Platform Phase 1: Foundation
description: Supabase DB + VitalRing API + Auth + Mock Data + Core UI Shell

stories.title: Supabase client + environment config
acceptanceCriteria: lib/supabase/client.ts exports createClient() for browser use
lib/supabase/server.ts exports createServerClient() for server components
lib/supabase/admin.ts exports createAdminClient() with service role key
.env.local.example exists with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders
TypeScript compiles with no errors (npx tsc --noEmit)

stories.title: Database schema SQL migration file
acceptanceCriteria: supabase/schema.sql exists with CREATE TABLE statements for: profiles, members, organizations, vitals, health_analyses, alerts, subscriptions, payments, vital_cash, partner_referrals
vitals table has index on (member_id, measured_at DESC)
RLS policies exist for: guardians see only linked members, org admins see only their org members
profiles table has role ENUM: member, guardian, org_admin, platform_admin
vital_cash table has transaction_type ENUM: earn, burn with reason field
SQL syntax is valid PostgreSQL

stories.title: Mock data seed script
acceptanceCriteria: supabase/seed.ts exists and generates 10 mock members with Korean names and ages 65-85
Generates 30 days of vitals per member with realistic ranges (HR 55-90, HRV 15-60, SpO2 94-99, temp 35.5-37.2)
Generates pre-calculated VITA Scores (0-100) with risk_level classification
Generates 5 sample alerts (2 critical, 3 warning) with realistic messages
Generates 3 sample organizations (municipality, nursing home, enterprise)
Data is exportable as SQL INSERT statements or JSON

stories.title: VitalRing API webhook receiver
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/ingest/vitals/route.ts handles POST requests
Validates required fields: ring_id, measured_at, heart_rate
Returns 400 for invalid payload with error message
Returns 200 with {status: 'ok', alerts: []} for valid payload
Stores validated data in vitals table format (even if Supabase not connected, structure is correct)
Includes deduplication check on (ring_id + measured_at)
TypeScript compiles with no errors

stories.title: Auth pages (login + signup + onboarding)
acceptanceCriteria: app/auth/login/page.tsx renders email/password login form with Supabase Auth
app/auth/signup/page.tsx renders registration form with role selection (member/guardian/org_admin)
app/auth/callback/route.ts handles OAuth callback
Forms use shadcn/ui components with consistent VITA design system (teal/navy theme)
Error states are handled (invalid credentials, network error)
Responsive on mobile and desktop
Dark mode supported

stories.title: Authenticated app shell with sidebar layout
acceptanceCriteria: app/(app)/layout.tsx renders sidebar + main content area for authenticated users
Sidebar shows: Dashboard, Guardian, Vital Cash, Subscription, Settings menu items with lucide icons
Sidebar shows user name + role badge from profile
Sidebar collapses to icons on mobile (responsive)
Sidebar uses gradient-navy dark background matching VITA brand
app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx renders placeholder member dashboard
Marketing pages (/, /proposal, /platform, etc.) remain separate from app layout
Middleware redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login
Dark mode supported on all app shell elements

stories.title: Member dashboard with mock data display
acceptanceCriteria: app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx displays VITA Score as circular progress (0-100)
Shows 4 vital cards: heart rate, SpO2, sleep duration, stress level
Shows AI coaching message card
Shows Vital Cash balance with recent earning history
Shows subscription status badge
Uses mock data (no real Supabase connection required for initial render)
Design matches premium healthcare aesthetic: glassmorphism cards, teal accents, smooth animations
Responsive mobile layout
Dark mode supported
